crumb-fallback: The header's crumb on a plugin's page while its name isn't known yet.
open-tab: Button (and its tooltip, and a menu item on phones) that opens the plugin's page in a new browser tab.
open.opening: Text on a plugin's page while it opens the plugin in a new tab (a plugin that runs outside Socio).
open.opened: Text once the new tab opened.
open.blocked: Error when the browser blocked the new tab (a pop-up blocker).
open.failed: Error when the plugin could not be opened, without a reason from the server.
link.title: Title of the workspace's own confirmation before it opens a link a plugin asked for. <host> wraps {{host}}, the link's full host name (like www.example.com); keep the tag around it.
link.description: The confirmation's text. {{plugin}} is the plugin's name, {{host}} the link's host name. It's a safety warning: keep it plain.
link.cancel: Button that doesn't open the link; it has the focus.
link.open: Button that opens the link in a new tab.
